summary: Changed rate $20 -> $28 (engine; county text still $20). Confirmed 10 full-hookup 20/30/50 sites, May 1-Oct 15, online booking. Added showers, water, 36-50 ft pads. Pond holds; pin good.
flags: FEE CONFLICT: every site's booking panel shows '$28 /Night'; the same page's Fees line says '$20.00 per night' and the park page 'Cost per night is $20'. I didn't run a checkout. I wrote $28 because the engine is what charges, with the $20 in fees.note. Local, so no gate either way.

Waterfront: stored 'pond' holds. Imagery: the pads run west off the park road and their heads end ~5-15 m from the west pond's edge with only grass and a shrub line between. West pond ~35 x 190 m, ~1.6 acres; the east pond across the road ~1.5 ha, ~3.8 acres. Both are imagery estimates (Overpass timed out) and both under 5 acres, so pond, not lake. County calls them 'fishing ponds' only in the old note; its page says 'Fishing'.
Pin 43.0681,-95.6173 is on the pads (within ~30 m). The engine's own map point is 43.068479,-95.617312. No change.

Long-stay: 'can be reserved for the entire season or by the month' and 'Long term camping inquiries please call'. No share of seasonals is stated, so I can't say how many of the 10 go by the month; a county park that also sells nights. One 2023 upgrade line in the old note dropped, no page read states it. Old facility page 'Tjossem-Park-Campsites' says 'primitive restroom facilities'; the park page says 'Modern Shower building': I took the park page.

Google 3.0 from 2 reviews (too few to mean anything). WEBSITE: stored link is the retired combined facility page, still answering; the park page https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/OBrien/Park/Tjossem-Park is better. apply.py doesn't write website.
